statements: The Information Commissioner's power to impose a financial penalty for breach of data protection duties is the penalty notice under section 155 of the Data Protection Act 2018.

Section 157 sets a higher maximum amount of £17,500,000 or 4% of an undertaking's total annual worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year, whichever is higher, and a standard maximum amount of £8,700,000 or 2% on the same basis.
Section 115(9) makes the section 155 penalty notice the only route by which the administrative fine powers in Articles 58(2)(i) and 83 of the UK GDPR may be exercised.

Schedule 16 imposes a mandatory procedure: a notice of intent must be given first, allowing not less than 21 days for written representations, and the penalty notice must follow within 6 months of the notice of intent.
A penalty notice may be appealed to the Tribunal, including against the amount alone under section 162(3), and the Tribunal may substitute its own decision under section 163(3).
